review.assessment: This diff introduces three new write paths (importer, scheduler, webhook) but contains no logic to verify project status before mutation. It does not show a fourth path or any archive-verification logic anywhere in the tree it started from, leaving the compliance contract unmet.

findings.actual: All three modules blindly iterate over ops and call `project.write()` without checking whether the target project is archived. State mutates regardless of archival status.
findings.call: python -c "from workspace.importer import apply; from workspace.project import Project; idx = {'Borealis': Project(name='Borealis', archived=True)}; apply(idx, [{'project':'Borealis','field':'status'})]"
findings.expected: Operation should refuse and raise/return an error for the archived project, consistent with `docs/archiving.md`'s contract that archived projects do not change.
